mechanism: Citalopram (SSRI) increases serotonergic activity while sacubitril (neprilysin inhibitor) may potentiate serotonin effects by reducing its metabolism; combined use also increases hypotension risk due to citalopram's vasodilatory properties and sacubitril's vasodilator mechanism.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms and hypotension; blood pressure and heart rate monitoring recommended; dose adjustment of citalopram may be necessary given maximum recommended dose is 40 mg daily in most populations.
